Liable,Ⓒa.Ⓓyogya, aDIna, arha, vaSa in comp.; gen. ex. by arh 1 P, pAtraM, Alu or SIla in comp., or by pot. pass. part.; ‘l(iable) to punishment’ daMqanIya, daMqayogya, daMqArha; ‘l(iable) to be blamed’ niMdApAtraM; ‘l(iable) to fall’ patayAlu, patanaSIla; ‘man is l(iable) to err’ manuzyAH sKalanaSIlAH-pramAdADInAH; See Apt also.
Ⓑ
 2 anuyogADIna, prazwavya, AhvAnADIna, aBiyojya.
